title: Where can you fly direct from Cardiff Airport?
author: Brogan
intro: Cardiff is a small airport, but between TUI, Ryanair, KLM and Vueling it has direct flights to the sun spots most people want, plus Amsterdam for connections. Here's where you can go, and what's new for 2026.
seo_title: Cardiff Airport direct flights: where you can go (2026)
seo_description: TUI flies to about 25 sun spots from Cardiff, Ryanair to Alicante, Faro and Tenerife, KLM to Amsterdam. Summer and winter routes, checked for 2026.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Biggest airline:** TUI
- **TUI destinations:** about 25
- **New for 2026:** Faro and Hurghada
- **Connections:** KLM to Amsterdam

Cardiff is mostly a holiday airport, with flights to Spain, Portugal, the Canaries, Turkey, Egypt and Tunisia. We checked these routes in October 2026 from airline and airport announcements. Routes change every season, so check the airline's own timetable before you plan a trip around one.

sections.heading: Who flies from Cardiff
sections.text:
| Airline | What it flies | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TUI | Package holidays and flights, all year | Tenerife, Palma, Antalya, Hurghada |
| Ryanair | Cheap flights to sun and Dublin | Alicante, Faro, Tenerife, Dublin |
| KLM | Twice-daily flights to its hub | Amsterdam |
| Vueling | Summer flights to Spain | Alicante, Málaga |

TUI is by far the biggest airline at Cardiff. It based a fourth aircraft there for summer 2026 and says it has around 25 destinations on sale, with more than 50 flights a week at the peak.

sections.heading: Summer sun
sections.text:
In summer, most of Cardiff's flights head south for beach holidays:

- **Spain and the islands:** [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca) (Palma), Alicante for the [Costa Blanca](/destinations/altea), [Málaga](/destinations/malaga), and [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) and [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) in the Canaries.
- **Portugal:** Faro for the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve), new with TUI from May 2026 and also flown by Ryanair.
- **Further afield:** [Antalya](/destinations/antalya) in Turkey, Enfidha for Tunisia, and Hurghada on Egypt's Red Sea coast, new with TUI from May 2026, twice a week.

[Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura), added for winter 2025, is also staying on the summer programme.

sections.heading: Winter sun and snow
sections.text:
Cardiff's winter programme is smaller but covers the main winter sun islands, with TUI flying to:

| Destination | Island or region | Typical January high |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) | Canary Islands | About 21°C |
| [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura) | Canary Islands | About 20°C |
| [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) | Canary Islands | About 21°C |
| Alicante | Costa Blanca, Spain | About 17°C |

TUI also runs seasonal ski and Lapland flights from Cardiff, and Palma stays on into winter. The temperatures are from our destination guides.

Tip: winter sun from Cardiff sells out fastest around February half term and Christmas, because there's only one or two flights a week to each island. Book early, or compare with Bristol, about an hour away.

sections.heading: Cities and connections
sections.text:
Cardiff doesn't have many city break routes, but two are useful:

- **Amsterdam with KLM:** twice daily, for a weekend in [Amsterdam](/destinations/amsterdam) or to connect onwards to KLM's worldwide network on one ticket.
- **Dublin with Ryanair:** daily in summer, for a short break in the Irish capital.

Local knowledge: the KLM link means you can fly long-haul from Cardiff without going to Heathrow, changing at Schiphol to places like [New York](/destinations/new-york), Cape Town or Bali. Check the connection time when you book.

sections.heading: Getting to Cardiff Airport
sections.text:
The airport is at Rhoose in the Vale of Glamorgan, about 12 miles south-west of Cardiff city centre.

- **By train:** Rhoose Cardiff International Airport station is on the Vale of Glamorgan line from Cardiff Central, with a short shuttle bus to the terminal.
- **By bus:** an express bus links the airport with Cardiff city centre; check the current route and times before you travel.
- **By car:** the airport has short and long stay car parks, and booking ahead is usually cheaper.

Because it's small, Cardiff is quick to get through, and our posts on how early to arrive at [Bristol](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-bristol-airport) and [Birmingham](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-birmingham-airport) cover the bigger airports nearby.

sections.heading: Cardiff, Bristol or Birmingham?
sections.text: Cardiff's big advantages are that it's quiet, quick to get through, and close for anyone in South Wales. Its drawback is choice: many routes fly only once or twice a week. [Bristol](/blog/where-can-you-fly-direct-from-bristol-airport) has far more routes, especially city breaks with easyJet, and [Birmingham](/blog/where-can-you-fly-direct-from-birmingham-airport) has long-haul. If the route you want from Cardiff doesn't fit your dates, it's worth checking both.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Cardiff?
sections.text:
Cardiff's TUI flights make a week in the sun easy:

- **Summer:** [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca) or the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve)
- **Winter:** [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) or [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura)

The [beach holidays](/destinations/beach-holidays) and [February half term](/destinations/february-half-term-holidays) pages have more ideas. If your family can't agree, read our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday), or put everyone's picks into a draw on somewhere.party.

faqs.question: Which airlines fly from Cardiff Airport?
faqs.answer: TUI is the biggest, with Ryanair, KLM and Vueling also flying from Cardiff. Routes and airlines change by season.

faqs.question: What new routes are there from Cardiff in 2026?
faqs.answer: TUI added Faro from May 2026 and Hurghada in Egypt from 2 May 2026, and kept Fuerteventura on for summer after launching it for winter 2025.

faqs.question: Can you fly long-haul from Cardiff Airport?
faqs.answer: Not directly, but KLM flies twice a day to Amsterdam, where you can connect to long-haul flights on the same ticket.

faqs.question: Can you fly from Cardiff to the Canary Islands in winter?
faqs.answer: Yes. TUI flies from Cardiff to Lanzarote, Fuerteventura and Gran Canaria in winter, and Ryanair flies to Tenerife.
